title: Slot-based release scheduling and sweepback runbook for mixed-surface release trains
creator: Natalie Rivera
description: Problem: coordinating multi-surface (runtime, console, API) releases is creating unpredictable contention windows and manual firefighting on release days. Goal: define a slot-based scheduling model and an operator sweepback runbook that (1) enforces non-overlapping critical windows across teams, (2) provides automated 'sweepback' policies to roll back lower-risk surfaces when a higher-risk surface causes degradation, and (3) publishes an auditable day-of runbook for SRE/PM/Eng. Scope: slot model, release slot calendar, gating criteria, signal thresholds, sweepback policy matrix, canary size prescriptions, and a standard day-of checklist. Out of scope for this ticket: implementing scheduler automation in infra (separate ENG initiative).
acceptance_criteria: A slot model document exists describing slot durations, ownership, and escalation paths
A sweepback policy matrix maps signal classes (errors, latency, token-cost anomalies) to actions per surface
Day-of runbook with roles/contact table, pre-flight checks, and rollback recipes is published and reviewed
Cross-team calendar entries (runtime/console/api) are templated and a sample 8-week calendar is produced
At least one dry-run simulation with SRE and reps from runtime/console/api is completed and feedback captured
